bias.en: Downtrend · lost $40, lowest close since February
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $40，收盘创 2月以来新低

read.en: AAOI fell 3.3% on Nov 19 to $39.46, trading $39.38–43.62. It is below the 5-day ($44.1), 10-day ($48.0), 30-day ($67.1), 100-day ($99.0) and 200-day ($115.0); all but the 200-day are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 16 ($55.91), and RSI is 29.2.
read.zh: AAOI 11月19日下跌 3.3%，收于 $39.46，盘中区间 $39.38–43.62。股价位于 5 日（$44.1）、10 日（$48.0）、30 日（$67.1）、100 日（$99.0）和 200 日均线（$115.0）下方；除 200 日均线外均在下行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月16日起看空（$55.91），RSI 为 29.2。

read.en: The $43.62 high was rejected above the $42.3–42.7 band, and the close broke the $40 support, now resistance, the lowest close since Feb 5. Resistance is $40–40.8 (round number, Nov 18 close), then $42.3–43.6 (Nov 18 high, Nov 17 low, Nov 19 high) and $44.1–45.2 (5-day, Nov 16 low). Support is $37.0–37.6, then $35.4–35.7 (January lows). A close above $40.8 would target $42.3–43.6; below $37.0, $35.4–35.7.
